title: Distinct subsequences
statement: Count the distinct ways (by index positions) that t occurs as a subsequence of s. Answers fit in 64 bits.
hints: dp[i][j] = the ways for t[:j] inside s[:i].
Each s character either isn't used, or (if it equals t[j−1]) is used as t's j-th character.

solution.explanation: A counting version of LCS: dp[i][j] = dp[i−1][j] (skip s[i−1]) + [s[i−1] = t[j−1]] · dp[i−1][j−1] (use it). Rolling into one row requires iterating j downward, for the same reason as 0/1 knapsack: each s character may be used at most once per subsequence.
